user.title: ABRP credentials
user.description: Enter your Iternio (ABRP) telemetry API key and your personal user token.

vehicle.title: Select vehicle
vehicle.description: Choose the MySkoda vehicle to send telemetry for.

car_model_manufacturer.title: Vehicle manufacturer
car_model_manufacturer.description: Used to look up the ABRP car model identifier.

car_model.title: Vehicle model
car_model.description: Select the closest matching model for {manufacturer}.

car_model_manual.title: Vehicle model (manual entry)
car_model_manual.description: The ABRP model list could not be loaded. Enter the ABRP car_model identifier manually, or leave it blank to let ABRP use the vehicle profile's default model.

entities.title: Entity mapping
entities.description: Pre-filled from your MySkoda vehicle where possible. Leave a field empty to skip that value entirely.

interval.title: Send interval
interval.description: How often to send a telemetry heartbeat, in seconds. An update is also sent immediately whenever the charge state changes.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter ABRP credentials
reauth_confirm.description: ABRP rejected the configured API key or user token. Enter valid credentials to resume telemetry.

error.invalid_auth: ABRP rejected the API key or user token.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the ABRP API. Please try again.

abort.no_myskoda_devices: No MySkoda vehicle was found. Set up the MySkoda integration first.

init.title: MySkoda → ABRP options
init.description: Change credentials, the ABRP car model, entity mapping, send interval and fine-tuning.

data.only_on_change: Only send heartbeat when the payload changed
